text: Let’s see different methods perform data: Since actual drift happens position 501, methods detecting drift closer point accurate.
code: methods <- c("ddm", "eddm", "hddm_a", "page_hinkley", "kswin")  results_list <- lapply(methods, function(m) {   res <- detect_drift(stream, method = m, include_warnings = FALSE)   data.frame(     Method = toupper(m),     Detections = nrow(res),     First_Detection = if(nrow(res) > 0) min(res$index) else NA   ) })  comparison <- do.call(rbind, results_list) print(comparison) #>         Method Detections First_Detection #> 1          DDM          1             560 #> 2         EDDM          3             403 #> 3       HDDM_A          1             517 #> 4 PAGE_HINKLEY          1             650 #> 5        KSWIN          2             516

title: Getting Started with datadriftR
text: methods (DDM, EDDM, HDDM) provide two levels alerts: Warning: Early signal drift might occurring Drift: Confirmed detection concept drift
code: # Get both warnings and drift detections all_alerts <- detect_drift(stream, method = "ddm", include_warnings = TRUE) table(all_alerts$type) #>  #>   drift warning  #>       1     328  # Get only confirmed drift drift_only <- detect_drift(stream, method = "ddm", include_warnings = FALSE) nrow(drift_only) #> [1] 1

title: Getting Started with datadriftR
text: method parameters can adjust control sensitivity:
code: # KSWIN: Lower alpha = more conservative (fewer false alarms) conservative <- detect_drift(stream, method = "kswin",                              alpha = 0.001, window_size = 100)  # KSWIN: Higher alpha = more sensitive (catches drift faster) sensitive <- detect_drift(stream, method = "kswin",                           alpha = 0.01, window_size = 100)  cat("Conservative approach:", nrow(conservative), "detections\n") #> Conservative approach: 2 detections cat("Sensitive approach:", nrow(sensitive), "detections\n") #> Sensitive approach: 2 detections

title: Getting Started with datadriftR
text: KSWIN Page-Hinkley work well continuous numeric data:
code: set.seed(42)  # Continuous stream: mean shifts from 0 to 1 at position 301 continuous_stream <- c(   rnorm(300, mean = 0, sd = 1),   rnorm(300, mean = 1, sd = 1) )  # Detect the mean shift results <- detect_drift(continuous_stream, method = "kswin",                         alpha = 0.005, window_size = 100, stat_size = 30)  if(nrow(results) > 0) {   cat("Drift detected at position:", min(results$index), "\n")   cat("(Actual drift occurred at position 301)\n") } #> Drift detected at position: 128  #> (Actual drift occurred at position 301)
